W_body_split_keeps_its_own_lf_only_regex._note: Ratchet site. The reason is structural and is good news: each WIRING mutant re-introduces the literal `/^---\n` into `packages/cli/src`, which is exactly the form E3 asserts is extinct. So E3 is a live ratchet with a demonstrated flip, not a pin — it would be satisfiable by a broken grep otherwise, and its own canary only proves the predicate, not that anything can trip it.
